WHO Guideline on Self-Care Interventions for Health and Well-Being | Publisher: World Heal
Chapter 4: Integrative Health & Self-Care Governance
Integrative health traditions, including traditional lifestyle practices,
should be evaluated against safety principles. Guidelines for Traditional
Lifestyle Practices: 1. Lifestyle & Rest: Traditional practices focusing
on warm water hydration, mindful breathing, and structured sleep alignment
are supported for general wellness. 2. Safety Disclaimers: Traditional
lifestyle practices are non-pharmacological educational options and should
never replace emergency medical care. 3. Quality Control: Avoid unverified
commercial oral mixtures or unregulated compounds.
